content.title: Atraca al ladrón
about: Atraca al ladrón is a tabletop deduction game for 2–4 players. The goal is to discover every other player's secret PIN before they discover yours.

Each round, players simultaneously play two truth cards and one lie card (with optional one-time tokens to flip a card or to mark an opponent's lie), then take turns guessing a player's PIN and receive feedback on correct digits and positions.
features: PIN deduction phase with Mastermind-style feedback (correct digits / correct positions)
Simultaneous card selection (2 truths + 1 lie) to generate information and bluffing
One-time tokens: flip a card (NO) and mark an opponent's lie
Wildcard cards to state special facts about your PIN
Designed for ages 6+ and quick rounds
learnings: Balancing hidden-information games so players always feel they have actionable clues
Designing bluffing tools that create tension without stalling the game
Iterating rules for clarity and pacing through playtests
